queue.title: Gym site checklist
queue.caption:
Quick check for gym owners. Does your website have these three?

1. Your timetable, up to date. People want to know when they can come.
2. Clear prices. Hidden prices make people click away.
3. A free class button that's easy to find. Make the first step simple.

Missing one? We can help.

#gymowner #boxinggym #gymtips #sydneyfitness

queue.title: Built with AI
queue.caption:

It helps us design and build fast, which is how we keep prices low. But every site and every post gets checked by me before it goes anywhere. 66 fights taught me to sweat the details, so wrong class times or made up claims don't get past me.

Charles, Rocket Power Tech

queue.title: Google profile tip
queue.caption:
Before people find your website, they often find your Google profile first. It's free, and it's worth ten minutes this week.

Check your opening hours are right, add a few real photos of your gym, and reply to every review, good or bad.

Small fixes, big first impression.

#gymowner #boxinggym #sydneygyms #gymtips

queue.title: Do I need to write anything
queue.caption:
One of the most common worries we hear: I don't have time to write website copy.

You don't have to. Fill in a short form, have a quick chat about your gym, and we write everything. You just check it sounds like you.

#gymowner #boxinggym #personaltrainer #smallbusinesssydney

queue.title: Clear beats fancy
queue.caption:
You don't need animations, videos or ten pages.

You need your timetable, your prices, where you are, and an easy way to book a first class. Get those four right and your site is already doing its job.

#gymwebsite #boxinggym #gymowner #sydneyfitness

queue.title: 3 photos every gym needs
queue.caption:
Stock photos don't sell a gym. Real ones do.

Three shots worth taking this week:
1. The floor, clean and set up before a class.
2. Your coaches, looking like people someone would want to train with.
3. A class in full swing, so people can picture themselves there.

Phone photos are fine. Good light matters more than a good camera.

#gymowner #boxinggym #gymphotos #sydneygyms

queue.title: Before and after
